message.name: AgentCANotificationAdviceV03
message.definition: Scope|This message is sent by an issuer (or its agent) to a CSD to:|- Provide a CSD with the details of a corporate action along with the possible options available to the clients of that CSD; and|- to update a corporate action notification. A notification advice can be initially sent as a preliminary advice and subsequently replaced by another notification advice with updated information.|Usage|This message is used:|- to provide a CSD with the details of a corporate action along with the possible options available to the clients of that CSD. The information can be complete or incomplete.|- to update a corporate action notification advice. A notification advice can be initially sent as a preliminary advice and subsequently replaced by another notification advice with updated information. As per SMPG recommendation, all the information should be provided in the update, not only updated information.|An Agent Corporate Action Notification Status Advice is sent in reply to the Agent Corporate Action Notification Advice.|Note: The amendment of a corporate action notification is done through a replacement mechanism in line with both the ISO 15022 messages used in the flow between the CSD and its clients, and the ISO 20022 proxy voting messages.

rules.name: NotificationTypeGuideline
rules.text: NotificationType REPL is used to replace a previously sent CorporateActionNotification message.

rules.name: WithLinkageRule
rules.text: If Code WITH is used, then the one or more instruction which are linked become bound and which must be executed together. Even if one single transactions/instructions/notifications can not be executed, then all the other transactions/instructions/notifications must also be kept pending. Therefore the use of code WITH must be limited to combine up to 2 or 3 transactions/instructions/notifications.

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: If Code is present, the code OTHR (Other) must only be used if no other corporate action event code is appropriate. ||If Code is present, the code CHAN (Change) must only be used if no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. ||If Code is present, the code REDM (Final Maturity) must only be used if the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: PreviousNextFactorRule
rules.text: In case of partial redemption by pool factor, PreviousFactor provides the factor applicable before redemption and NextFactor provides the factor applicable after redemption.

rules.name: MaturityDateRule
rules.text: Maturity date may only provide generic information about the final maturity of the underlying instrument.

rules.name: OfficialCorporateActionEventReference
rules.text: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the structure and usage of the Official Corporate Action Event Reference (COAF). These recommendations are available in the SMPG Global Market Practices Part 1 document on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: EffectiveDateRule
rules.text: Effective date is to be used in events where there is no concept of entitlement, for example Name Change (CHAN) or Place of Incorporation (PLAC), and in events where there is a sense of eligibility but with a legal obligation, for example Merger (MRGR).

rules.name: InterestPeriodRule
rules.text: InterestPeriod must be used only if it is different from a normal accrued interest period.

rules.name: DeclaredRateRule
rules.text: DeclaredRate may only be used if the dividend or interest declared by the issuer is actually paid in a different currency than the declared one or if the dividend or the interest event makes it possible to elect amongst multiple currency options.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: MaximumAndMinimumQuantitySoughtUsageRule
rules.text: When MaximumQuantity is present, MinimumQuantitySought must be present too. When MinimumQuantitySought is present, MaximumQuantity must be present too.|When MinimumQuantitySought/Code is AnyAndAll, then MaximumQuantity/Code must not be AnyAndAll.|When MaximumQuantity/Code is AnyAndAll, MinimumQuantitySought/code must not be used with the value AnyAndAll.

rules.name: ConcurrentCallRule
rules.text: If ConcurrentCallIndicator is Yes, then Lottery FeatureType must be present.

rules.name: AdditionalInformationRule
rules.text: The AdditionalInformation field in all elements must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed or advised differently in the element definition.

rules.name: DissenterRights1UGRule
rules.text: If OfferType/Code value is equal to DISS (DissenterRights), then OfferType/Code value equal to NDIS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

rules.name: DissenterRights2UGRule
rules.text: If OfferType/Code value is equal to NDIS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable), then OfferType/Code value equal to DISS (DissenterRights) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

rules.name: DissenterRights1Rule
rules.text: If OfferType/Code value is equal to DISS (DissenterRights), then OfferType/Code value equal to NDIS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

rules.name: DissenterRights2Rule
rules.text: If OfferType/Code value is equal to NDISS (DissenterRightsNotApplicable), then OfferType/Code value equal to DISS (DissenterRights) is not allowed in any occurrence of OfferType.|(MT 564 NVR C27)

rules.name: AcceptancePriorityLevelUGRule
rules.text: If OfferType/Code is equal to AcceptancePriority (ACPR), then AcceptancePriorityLevel must be present.

rules.name: RateStatusGuideline
rules.text: The code value ACTU is the default value for a rate status.

rules.name: GrossDistributionRate2Rule
rules.text: If GrossDistributionRate is repeated, then:|- RateTypeAndAmountAndRateStatus/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of GrossDividendRate. (MT 564 NVR C8).

rules.name: GrossDistributionRate3Rule
rules.text: Only a single occurrence of either GrossDistributionRate/Amount or GrossDistributionRate/AmountAndRateStatus or GrossDistributionRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, only one of these elements may be present. (MT 564 NVR C7).

rules.name: NetDistributionRate1Rule
rules.text: If NetDistributionRate is repeated, then RateTypeAndAmountAndRateStatus/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of NetDistributionRate. (MT 564 NVR C8).

rules.name: NetDistributionRate2Rule
rules.text: Only a single occurrence of either NetDistributionRate/Amount or NetDistributionRate/AmountAndRateStatus or NetDistributionRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, and only one of these elements may be present. (MT 564 NVR C7).

rules.name: SecondLevelTax3Rule
rules.text: If at least one occurrence of SecondLevelTax is present, then at least one occurrence of WithholdingTaxRate must be present. (MT 564 NVR C19).

rules.name: WithholdingTaxRate1Rule
rules.text: If WithholdingTaxRate is repeated, then WithholdingTaxRate/RateTypeAndRate/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of WithholdingTaxRate. |(MT 564 NVR C8).

rules.name: WithholdingTaxRate2Rule
rules.text: Only a single occurrence of either WithholdingTaxRate/Amount or WithholdingTaxRate/Rate or WithholdingTaxRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, only one of those elements may be present. |(MT 564 NVR C7).

rules.name: SecondLevelTax1Rule
rules.text: If SecondLevelTax is repeated, then SecondLevelTax/RateTypeAndRate/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of SecondLevelTax. |(MT 564 NVR C8).

rules.name: SecondLevelTax2Rule
rules.text: Only a single occurrence of either SecondLevelTax/Amount or SecondLevelTax/Rate or SecondLevelTax/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, only one of these elements may be present. |(MT 564 NVR C7).

rules.name: PreviousNextFactorRule
rules.text: In case of partial redemption by pool factor, PreviousFactor provides the factor applicable before redemption and NextFactor provides the factor applicable after redemption.

rules.name: MaturityDateRule
rules.text: Maturity date may only provide generic information about the final maturity of the underlying instrument.

rules.name: GenericCashPricePerProductGuideline
rules.text: GenericCashPriceReceivedPerProduct and GenericCashPricePaidPerProduct are prices received or paid in the course of an event. The specific meaning (redemption price, subscription price, reinvestment price, etc.) is derived from the event type.

rules.name: IncomeTypeUsageRule
rules.text: The lists of income type codes to be used in IncomeType are provided in the document "ETYP-ITYP Exemption & Income Type Codes" available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

rules.name: ExemptionTypeUsageRule
rules.text: The lists of exemption type codes to be used in ExemptionType are provided in the document "ETYP-ITYP Exemption & Income Type Codes" available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

rules.name: IncomeType1Rule
rules.text: If at least one occurrence of OtherIncomeType is present, then IncomeType must be present.

rules.name: NetDistributionRate1Rule
rules.text: If NetDistributionRate is repeated, then:|- RateTypeAndAmountAndRateStatus/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of NetDistributionRate. (MT 564 NVR C8).

rules.name: GrossDistributionRate2Rule
rules.text: If GrossDistributionRate is repeated, then:|- RateTypeAndAmountAndRateStatus/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of GrossDistributionRate. (MT 564 NVR C8).

rules.name: GrossDistributionRate3Rule
rules.text: Only a single occurrence of either GrossDistributionRate/Amount or GrossDistributionRate/AmountAndRateStatus or GrossDDistributionRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, and only one of these elements may be present.|(MT 564 NVR C7).

rules.name: NetDistributionRate2Rule
rules.text: Only a single occurrence of either NetDistributionRate/Amount or NetDistributionRate/AmountAndRateStatus or NetDistributionRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, and only one of these elements may be present.|(MT 564 NVR C7).

rules.name: SecondLevelTax3Rule
rules.text: If at least one occurrence of SecondLevelTax is present, then at least one occurrence of WithholdingTaxRate must be present. (MT 564 NVR C19).

rules.name: SecondLevelTax1Rule
rules.text: If SecondLevelTax is repeated, then SecondLevelTax/RateTypeAndRate/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of SecondLevelTax. |(MT 564 NVR C8).

rules.name: SecondLevelTax2Rule
rules.text: Only a single occurrence of either SecondLevelTax/Amount or SecondLevelTax/Rate or SecondLevelTax/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, only one of these elements may be present. |(MT 564 NVR C7).

rules.name: WithholdingTaxRate1Rule
rules.text: If WithholdingTaxRate is repeated, then WithholdingTaxRate/RateTypeAndRate/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of WithholdingTaxRate. |(MT 564 NVR C8).

rules.name: WithholdingTaxRate2Rule
rules.text: Only a single occurrence of either WithholdingTaxRate/Amount or WithholdingTaxRate/Rate or WithholdingTaxRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, only one of these elements may be present. |(MT 564 NVR C7).

rules.name: DeemedRate1Rule
rules.text: If DeemedRate is repeated, then DeemedRate/RateTypeAndAmountAndRateStatus/RateType/Code values and DeemedRate/RateTypeAndRate/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of DeemedRate. |(MT 564 NVR C8).

rules.name: DeemedRate2Rule
rules.text: Only a single occurrence of either DeemedRate/Amount or DeemedRate/Rate or DeemedRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, only one of these elements may be present. |(MT 564 NVR C7).

rules.name: GenericCashPricePerProductGuideline
rules.text: GenericCashPriceReceivedPerProduct and GenericCashPricePaidPerProduct are prices received or paid in the course of an event. The specific meaning (redemption price, subscription price, reinvestment price, ETC.) is derived from the event type.

rules.name: GenericCashPricePerProductGuideline
rules.text: GenericCashPriceReceivedPerProduct and GenericCashPricePaidPerProduct are prices received or paid in the course of an event. The specific meaning (redemption price, subscription price, reinvestment price.) is derived from the event type.

rules.name: ExemptionTypeUsageRule
rules.text: The lists of exemption type codes to be used in ExemptionType are provided in the document "ETYP-ITYP Exemption & Income Type Codes" available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

rules.name: IncomeTypeUsageRule
rules.text: The lists of income type codes to be used in IncomeType are provided in the document "ETYP-ITYP Exemption & Income Type Codes" available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

rules.name: IncomeType2Rule
rules.text: If at least one occurrence of OtherIncomeType is present, then IncomeType must be present.

rules.name: AdditionalInformationRule
rules.text: The AdditionalInformation field in all elements must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed or advised differently in the element definition as in NarrativeVersion.

rules.name: AdditionalTextRule
rules.text: If OptionType/Code is OTHR (Other), then at least one occurrence of AdditionalInformation/AdditionalText/AdditionalInformation must be present.|(MT564 NVR C5).

rules.name: OptionNumberGuideline
rules.text: For differentiation between options, it is recommended to use the OptionNumber rather than the OptionType, for example, in the case where two or more offers can be described by the same corporate action option code.

rules.name: RevocabilityPeriodRule
rules.text: If WithdrawalAllowedIndicator is present and is 'true' or '1' (Yes), then PeriodDetails/RevocabilityPeriod must be present to indicate the period during which the withdrawal of instruction is allowed.

rules.name: OptionTypeUnknownProceedsUsageRule
rules.text: When used, the corporate action option type code PRUN (Unknown Proceeds) should be maintained throughout the full lifecycle of the event.

rules.name: InstructCashAmountRule
rules.text: If OptionFeatures/Code QCAS (InstructCashAmount) is not present, then any message elements in the list (PriceDetails/MaximumCashToInstruct, PriceDetails/MinimumCashToInstruct, PriceDetails/MinimumMutipleCashToInstruct) must not be present.|(MT564 NVR C20).

rules.name: BeneficialOwnerBreakdownRequestRule
rules.text: If in at least one occurrence of CorporateActionOptionDetails, OptionType/Code value is BOBD (BeneficialOwnerBreakdownRequest), then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code/PlainCorporateEventType value must be WTRC (Withholding Tax Relief Certification).|(MT 564 NVR C23).

rules.name: BeneficialOwnerBreakdownRequestUGRule
rules.text: If in at least one occurrence of CorporateActionOptionDetails, OptionType/Code value is BOBD (BeneficialOwnerBreakdownRequest), then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code/PlainCorporateEventType value must be WTRC (Withholding Tax Relief Certification).|(MT 564 NVR C23).

rules.name: BidInterval1Rule
rules.text: If BidInterval is present in CorporateActionDetails/RateAndAmountDetails, then BidInterval is not allowed in any occurences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/RateAndAmountDetails. |(MT 564 NVR C25)

rules.name: BidInterval2Rule
rules.text: If BidInterval is present in any occurrences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/RateAndAmountDetails, then BidInterval is not allowed in CorporateActionDetails/RateAndAmountDetails. |(MT 564 NVR C25)

rules.name: DeclaredRateRule
rules.text: If CorporateActionOptionDetails/RateAndAmountDetails/IssuerDeclaredExchangeRate is present, then CorporateActionDetails/RateAndAmountDetails/DeclaredRate must be present.

rules.name: FirstBidIncrementPrice1Rule
rules.text: If FirstBidIncrementPrice is present in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails, then FirstBidIncrementPrice is not allowed in any occurences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails. |(MT 564 NVR C24)

rules.name: FirstBidIncrementPrice2Rule
rules.text: If FirstBidIncrementPrice is present in any occurrences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails, then FirstBidIncrementPrice is not allowed in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails. |(MT 564 NVR C24)

rules.name: FirstBidIncrementPriceEventType1Rule
rules.text: If FirstBidIncrementPrice is present in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails, then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code value must be equal to either BIDS (Repurchase Offer) or DTCH (Dutch Auction) or TEND (Tender). |(MT 564 NVR C30)

rules.name: FirstBidIncrementPriceEventType2Rule
rules.text: If FirstBidIncrementPrice is present in any occurrence of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails, then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code value must be equal to either BIDS (Repurchase Offer) or DTCH (Dutch Auction) or TEND (Tender). |(MT 564 NVR C30)

rules.name: IncentivePremiumEventType1Rule
rules.text: If Code value is equal to INCP (IncentivePremiumPayment) in any occurrence of CorporateActionDetails/AdditionalBusinessProcessIndicator, then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code value must be equal to CONS (Consent).|(MT 564 NVR C26)

rules.name: IncentivePremiumEventTypeUG1Rule
rules.text: If Code value is equal to INCP (IncentivePremiumPayment) in any occurrence of CorporateActionDetails/AdditionalBusinessProcessIndicator, then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code/PlainCorporateEventType value must be equal to CONS (Consent).|(MT 564 NVR C26)

rules.name: InterestPaymentRule
rules.text: CorporateActionDetails/RateAndAmountDetails/InterestRate and CorporateActionOptionsDetails/RateAndAmountDetails/GrossInterestRateUsedforPayment must not be mixed. InterestRate is used to provide the annual rate of the financial instrument. GrossInterestRateUsedforPayment is used to provide the applicable rate for the current payment, after all calculations have been performed, that is, application of period and method of interest computation.

rules.name: IntermediateSecuritiesDistribution1Rule
rules.text: If CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code is RHDI (IntermediateSecuritiesDistribution), then CorporateActionDetails/|FollowingEventType must be present.|(MT 564 NVR C11).

rules.name: IssuerAgentGuideline
rules.text: AgentInformation/IssuerAgent must be used only in the communication between a CSD and local custodians.

rules.name: LastBidIncrementPrice1Rule
rules.text: If LastBidIncrementPrice is present in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails, then LastBidIncrementPrice is not allowed in any occurences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails. |(MT 564 NVR C24)

rules.name: LastBidIncrementPrice2Rule
rules.text: If LastBidIncrementPrice is present in any occurrences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails, then LastBidIncrementPrice is not allowed in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails.|(MT 564 NVR C24)

rules.name: LastBidIncrementPriceEventType1Rule
rules.text: If LastBidIncrementPrice is present in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails, then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code value must be equal to either BIDS (Repurchase Offer) or DTCH (Dutch Auction) or TEND (Tender). |(MT 564 NVR C30)

rules.name: LastBidIncrementPriceEventType2Rule
rules.text: If LastBidIncrementPrice is present in any occurrence of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails, then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code value must be equal to either BIDS (Repurchase Offer) or DTCH (Dutch Auction) or TEND (Tender). |(MT 564 NVR C30)

rules.name: MaximumPrice1Rule
rules.text: If MaximumPrice is present in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails, then MaximumPrice is not allowed in any occurences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails. |(MT 564 NVR C24)

rules.name: MaximumPrice2Rule
rules.text: If MaximumPrice is present in any occurrences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails, then MaximumPrice is not allowed in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails. |(MT 564 NVR C24)

rules.name: MinimumPrice1Rule
rules.text: If MinimumPrice is present in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails, then MinimumPrice is not allowed in any occurences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails. |(MT 564 NVR C24)

rules.name: MinimumPrice2Rule
rules.text: If MinimumPrice is present in any occurrences of CorporateActionOptionDetails/PriceDetails, then MinimumPrice is not allowed in CorporateActionDetails/PriceDetails. |(MT 564 NVR C24)

rules.name: NameChangeRule
rules.text: If CorporateActionDetails/AdditionalInformation/NewCompanyName/AdditionalInformation is present, then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code/PlainCorporateEventType value CHAN (Change) must be present and CorporateActionDetails/ChangeType/Code value NAME (Name) must be present in at least one occurrence of CorporateActionDetails/ChangeType.|(MT 564 NVR C10).

rules.name: NewMaturityDateRule
rules.text: If CorporateActionDetails/DateDetails/NewMaturityDate is present, then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code/PlainCorporateEventType must be EXTM (Maturity Extension).

rules.name: NotificationIdentification1Rule
rules.text: If NotificationGeneralInformation/NotificationType is REPL (Replacement) and Pagination/PageNumber is equal to value 1, then PreviousNotificationIdentification must be present. |(MT 564 NVR C9).

rules.name: NotificationIdentification2Rule
rules.text: If NotificationGeneralInformation/NotificationType is RMDR (Reminder) and Pagination/PageNumber is equal to value 1, then PreviousNotificationIdentification must be present. |(MT 564 NVR C9).

rules.name: OtherEventRule
rules.text: If CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code is OTHR (Other) then at least one occurrence of AdditionalInformation/AdditionalText/AdditionalInformation must be present.|(MT564 NVR C4).

rules.name: PaginationRule
rules.text: If pagination is present, then NotificationGeneralInformation/NotificationIdentification must be present.

rules.name: PaymentDateRule
rules.text: If at least one occurrence of CorporateActionOptionDetails/SecuritiesMovementDetails or at least one occurrence of CorporateActionOptionDetails/CashMovementDetails is present, then CorporateActionDetails/DateDetails/PaymentDate must be absent. (MT 564 NVR C16).

rules.name: RateAndCorporateActionEventRule
rules.text: If CorporateActionOptionDetails/RateAndAmountDetails/GrossDistributionRate/NotSpecifiedRate Code value or CorporateActionOptionDetails/RateAndAmountDetails/GrossInterestRateUsedForPayment/NotSpecifiedRate Code value is NILP (Nil Payment), then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code/PlainCorporateEventType must be either DVCA (CashDividend) or INTR (InterestPayment).|If CorporateActionOptionDetails/CashMovementDetails/RateAndAmountDetails/GrossDistributionRate/NotSpecifiedRate Code value or CorporateActionOptionDetails/CashMovementDetails/RateAndAmountDetails/GrossInterestRateUsedForPayment/NotSpecifiedRate Code value is NILP (Nil Payment), then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code/PlainCorporateEventType must be either DVCA (CashDividend) or INTR (InterestPayment).
